claim_ceiling: This stable package starts from the migration-selected Artifact Type contract, applies any recorded owner-review refinement, and binds its semantic dependencies to admitted Definitions. It does not admit the Artifact Type, admit any instance, authenticate fixture claims, integrate a consumer, or activate behavior.
distinct_validation_purpose: Binds one exact Product Capability version to typed owner-qualified realizations while keeping adoption, conformance, observations, operation, and value as separate claims.

name: Capability Realization Binding

orthogonality_rules.statement: Candidate identity and exact graph references do not authenticate owners or execute effects.
Maps product capability semantics to one or more realizations.
A realization endpoint, binding, Capability Instance, and Product Capability remain distinct identities with separate owners and lifecycle posture.
Candidate, adopted, conformant, observed, operational, and valuable are separate claims and cannot be inferred from one another.
